connector.name: SignaTrust
connector.registryDescription: Blockchain-anchored e-signatures: send envelopes, manage templates, verify anchors on Solana.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.signatrust. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIGNATRUST_API_KEY
env.description: SignaTrust API key (starts with sk_live_). Create one at Settings -> API keys.

env.name: SIGNATRUST_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://app.signatrust.io; set for self-hosted or local development.
